Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick reproduction and for the screenshot. Couple of troubleshooting steps while we open support with Coupa:

1) Try an incognito window and disable any browser password managers — sometimes the SSO redirect hits cached cookies.
2) On the create-account flow, use the "Continue without SSO" link (below the SSO button) to avoid IdP redirects.
3) If you can, forward me the exact IdP domain (the URL you land on) and the time of the failed attempt — I'll include that in the support ticket.

I've initiated a ticket with Coupa support (see below) but I'll also propose a short-term fall-back: we can create a temporary vendor record in our ERP so we can issue a one-off PO while Coupa support resolves identity mapping. For that I need:
- Completed W-9 or W-8
- Remittance address and AP contact email
- Tax ID / VAT number (if different entity)

Coupa support link (ticket created): https://coupa.com/support/tickets/CH-98172 (I've attached the ticket id to the Jira).

If you want, send the documents to me directly (secure link preferred) and I'll start the temp record.

Best,
Dev Patel
Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
